clips.title: The story
paras: A Sealed Crate is a turn-in task involving recovered trade goods that have fallen into the hands of highwaymen or were lost along commercial routes. Adventurers return intercepted cargo to trade handlers to secure regional supply lines and receive payment.

Wagon trails and shipping lanes have become treacherous due to a sharp rise in ambushes by bandits and thieves targeting trade caravans. Unsuspecting haulers and couriers frequently lose their shipments when caught unawares, leaving heavy sealed crates abandoned along wild roads and wilderness paths until someone recovers them.

Merchants and supply coordinators maintain standing bounties for the safe return of missing merchandise. Adventurers who retrieve displaced crates and haul them back to regional collection points help restore compromised distribution lines, earning direct monetary compensation for safeguarding commerce.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Another delivery! Fantastic. Set it over by the pile and we can discuss your compensation.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thank you for your hard work, friend. There has been an uprising in bandits and thieves intercepting trade routes as of late. If you find other crates lying around, please bring them here and we'll handle the rest.
